messages.en:
{07 16 00}No,{01 00 00 0a 00} I just can't stay up 
that late. I need my beauty
rest, you know!
{07 0b 00}Would you change it to a
time when it's still light
out, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ei,{01 00 00 0a 00} ma ei saa nii hilja
üleval olla. Mul on vaja
iluund, tead küll!
{07 0b 00}Kas muudaksid selle ajaks,
kui väljas on veel valge,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 16 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Well, that's no good.{01 00 00 0a 00} If I
stay up that late, I'll get
dark circles under my eyes.
And that would be tragic.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}Can we make it a time
when it's still light out?
messages.et:
{07 16 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Noh, see ei sobi.{01 00 00 0a 00} Kui ma
olen nii hilja üleval,
tekivad mul silma alla ringid.
Ja see oleks traagiline.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}Kas saaksime teha ajal,
kui väljas on veel valge?
